title: Non-invasive sonografic measurement of muscle mass in children - sarcopenia in chronic disease
summary:
It is shown that sarcopenia has an effect on the course of chronical diseases. With imaging-techniques like MRI or CT it is possible to show the muscle mass as one aspect for sarcopenia. Using radiation in pediatric patients has to be reduced. Also messurement with the MRI needs a lot of time.
In Pediatric Health Care the Ultrasound ist well known. Our idea is, to show that measurement the area of the M. psoas with ultrasound leeds to comparable values like the MRI- or CT-measurements of this muscle.
By good results we want to create an control-group with healthy children. Moreover compering the m. psoas area of healthy kids with the m. psosas area of kids with a chronic diseases by using the ultrasound.
conditions: Muscle wasting and atrophy, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Assessment of muscle mass (psoas muscle) with ct/mri and ultrasound at one time point

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- in the first part of the study there must be an indication for performing MRI or CT other than this study
- this is not applicable in the second part of the study where only ultrasound is performed
- signed informed consent from the caregiver
- signed informed consent from the participant
Exclusion criteria:
- during the first part of the study: patients with no indication for MRI or CT other than this study.
- no informed consent
- in those cases where an additional ultrasound examination is not reasonable for the patient due to his overall well-being
